description: Single-resource metadata edge cases: directory resource, resource resolved under a server URL prefix, resource not found, and malformed XML.

input.multistatus_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<d:multistatus xmlns:d="DAV:">
    <d:response>
        <d:href>/photos/</d:href>
        <d:propstat>
            <d:status>HTTP/1.1 200 OK</d:status>
            <d:prop>
                <d:resourcetype><d:collection/></d:resourcetype>
                <d:getlastmodified>Tue, 02 Feb 2021 12:30:00 GMT</d:getlastmodified>
                <d:displayname>photos</d:displayname>
                <d:creationdate>2021-02-02T12:30:00Z</d:creationdate>
            </d:prop>
        </d:propstat>
    </d:response>
</d:multistatus>

cases.expected_output:
created=2021-02-02T12:30:00Z
name=photos
modified=Tue, 02 Feb 2021 12:30:00 GMT
size=None
etag=None
content_type=None
